title: Introduction to Deep Learning and TensorFlow
description: Understand the evolution of AI, master NumPy fundamentals, install TensorFlow, and implement gradient descent from scratch.
objectives: Understand the historical evolution of AI and deep learning
Distinguish between AI, ML, and deep learning paradigms
Implement gradient descent optimization from scratch
keyTakeaways: Gradient descent = iteratively step against the loss gradient to minimize a cost function
Learning rate controls step size; too large diverges, too small stalls — schedule or tune it
tf.GradientTape records forward ops for reverse-mode autodiff; use tf.Variable or tape.watch() for non-variables
NumPy broadcasting extends dimensions of size 1 to match the other operand — shapes must be compatible
The deep learning revolution was fueled by large datasets (ImageNet), GPUs, and algorithmic advances (ReLU, batch norm)
